# Estuary Restoration Programme: Annual Status Report

## Site Summary

The programme currently manages six restoration sites across the estuary. The
table below summarises their status at the end of the reporting year.

| Site      | Area (ha) | Year Breached | Vegetation Cover | Status      |
| --------- | --------- | ------------- | ---------------- | ----------- |
| Saltmere  | 210       | 2024          | 12%              | Establishing |
| Reedy Flat| 95        | 2021          | 64%              | On track     |
| Holm Bay  | 140       | 2019          | 81%              | Mature       |
| Kerr Point| 60        | 2022          | 47%              | On track     |
| Dunmoor   | 175       | 2020          | 73%              | Mature       |
| West Cut  | 88        | 2023          | 28%              | Establishing |

## Budget Allocation

Spending for the year is broken down by category in the table below.

| Category          | Budget (£k) | Spent (£k) | Variance |
| ----------------- | ----------- | ---------- | -------- |
| Engineering works | 1,200       | 1,145      | -55      |
| Monitoring        | 320         | 338        | +18      |
| Planting          | 210         | 196        | -14      |
| Community liaison  | 85          | 92         | +7       |

## Notes

Variances within ten percent of budget are considered acceptable and require no
corrective action. The monitoring overspend reflects additional bird surveys
requested after the Saltmere breach.

## Recommendations

The programme board recommends maintaining current funding levels and prioritising
planting at the two establishing sites in the coming year.
